description: Join a premier rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA). This full-time role offers a rewarding opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and well-being within a supportive environment.As a COTA, you will work closely with occupational therapists to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain independence in daily living activities. This position is ideal for a dedicated professional eager to make a significant impact on patients' lives.
requirements: Current Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) certification
Active Florida state licensure as a COTA
Previous experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility preferred
Ability to commit to a full-time schedule
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for COTA/PTA is $28.00 - $37.00. Compensation for PT/OT/ST is $40.00 - $50.00.
